title: 4 Ways to Fix Your Attention Span

cues.text: In 2016, a group of researchers— oh, a new photo.
cues.en: In 2016, a group of researchers— oh, a new photo.
cues.zh: 2016 年，一群研究人員——

cues.text: These researchers set out to measure— did I get that email?
cues.en: These researchers set out to measure— did I get that email?
cues.zh: 這些研究人員開始著手測量——

cues.text: They measured— what was that? Sorry.
cues.en: They measured— what was that? Sorry.
cues.zh: 他們測量——

cues.text: The researchers set out to measure the length of, well, our attention spans.
cues.en: The researchers set out to measure the length of, well, our attention spans.
cues.zh: 這些研究人員開始著手測量 人們的注意力持續時間。

cues.text: Participants downloaded a program that tracked how long they stayed focused
cues.en: Participants downloaded a program that tracked how long they stayed focused
cues.zh: 參與者下載了一個程式，

cues.text: on a single computer application before switching to another.
cues.en: on a single computer application before switching to another.
cues.zh: 這個程式會追蹤他們 在單一電腦應用程式持續專注多久，

cues.text: On average, users stuck with a single task for 40 seconds,
cues.en: On average, users stuck with a single task for 40 seconds,
cues.zh: 平均而言，使用者專注處理 同一項任務的時間只有 40 秒，

cues.text: down from 75 seconds, measured just five years earlier.
cues.en: down from 75 seconds, measured just five years earlier.
cues.zh: 比五年前測得的 75 秒還要短。

cues.text: This doesn’t necessarily mean our attention spans
cues.en: This doesn’t necessarily mean our attention spans
cues.zh: 這並不一定表示我們的注意力持續時間 真的正在逐漸縮短。

cues.text: are fundamentally getting shorter.
cues.en: are fundamentally getting shorter.
cues.zh: 更確切地說，在現今的世界裡，

cues.text: Rather, in today’s world,
cues.en: Rather, in today’s world,
cues.zh: 更確切地說，在現今的世界裡，

cues.text: our attention is being pulled in more directions than ever before.
cues.en: our attention is being pulled in more directions than ever before.
cues.zh: 我們的注意力比以往 更容易被拉向各個不同方向。

cues.text: This can make finding focus— for work, school, and even the things we love—
cues.en: This can make finding focus— for work, school, and even the things we love—
cues.zh: 這讓我們幾乎無法集中精神，

cues.text: feel almost impossible.
cues.en: feel almost impossible.
cues.zh: 幸好，我們有方法可以提升 並更妥善地保護自己的注意力，

cues.text: Thankfully, there are ways we can improve and better protect our attention spans,
cues.en: Thankfully, there are ways we can improve and better protect our attention spans,
cues.zh: 幸好，我們有方法可以提升 並更妥善地保護自己的注意力，

cues.text: both online and off.
cues.en: both online and off.
cues.zh: 無論是在網路上，還是在日常生活中。

cues.text: Our brains are constantly receiving a flood of information,
cues.en: Our brains are constantly receiving a flood of information,
cues.zh: 我們的大腦不斷接收大量資訊，

cues.text: from sensory input to environmental cues to internal thoughts.
cues.en: from sensory input to environmental cues to internal thoughts.
cues.zh: 包含感官輸入、環境線索， 以及內在的想法。

cues.text: Filtering through it all relies on several brain regions.
cues.en: Filtering through it all relies on several brain regions.
cues.zh: 要從所有資訊篩選出需要注意的內容， 仰賴大腦的幾個區域。

cues.text: The prefrontal cortex helps us decide what to pay attention to,
cues.en: The prefrontal cortex helps us decide what to pay attention to,
cues.zh: 前額葉皮質會幫助我們決定該注意什麼，

cues.text: while the parietal cortex shines a mental flashlight
cues.en: while the parietal cortex shines a mental flashlight
cues.zh: 而頂葉皮質則像一支心智探照燈，

cues.text: on that prioritized stream of information while ignoring the rest.
cues.en: on that prioritized stream of information while ignoring the rest.
cues.zh: 照亮我們優先關注的資訊， 同時忽略其他內容。

cues.text: The challenge of sustained attention is keeping that flashlight
cues.en: The challenge of sustained attention is keeping that flashlight
cues.zh: 持續專注的挑戰，就在於 讓這支探照燈一直照在同一個地方。

cues.text: focused in one place.
cues.en: focused in one place.
cues.zh: 大腦會持續監測所有彼此競爭的訊號，

cues.text: The brain is continuously monitoring all these competing signals.
cues.en: The brain is continuously monitoring all these competing signals.
cues.zh: 大腦會持續監測所有彼此競爭的訊號，

cues.text: And it redirects your focus if anything is flagged
cues.en: And it redirects your focus if anything is flagged
cues.zh: 它會重新引導你的注意力——

cues.text: as particularly novel, unexpected, or emotionally charged—
cues.en: as particularly novel, unexpected, or emotionally charged—
cues.zh: 只要發現特別新奇、出乎意料 或帶有強烈情緒的訊號，

cues.text: whether it’s a knock on the door, a notification, or even a passing thought.
cues.en: whether it’s a knock on the door, a notification, or even a passing thought.
cues.zh: 不管那是敲門聲、訊息通知， 甚至只是一閃而過的念頭。

cues.text: This ability to constantly scan our environments and quickly refocus
cues.en: This ability to constantly scan our environments and quickly refocus
cues.zh: 這種持續掃描周遭環境 並迅速重新集中注意力的能力，

cues.text: was key for human survival.
cues.en: was key for human survival.
cues.zh: 是人類得以生存的關鍵。

cues.text: So, while frustrating, getting distracted is inevitable.
cues.en: So, while frustrating, getting distracted is inevitable.
cues.zh: 因此，雖然分心令人懊惱， 卻是無可避免的。

cues.text: And our baseline ability to manage distractions can vary
cues.en: And our baseline ability to manage distractions can vary
cues.zh: 而我們天生就有的抗幹擾能力，

cues.text: based on factors like genetics and brain differences.
cues.en: based on factors like genetics and brain differences.
cues.zh: 也會因遺傳和大腦的 個體差異而有所不同。

cues.text: But no matter your starting point,
cues.en: But no matter your starting point,
cues.zh: 不過，不論你的起點在哪裡，

cues.text: there are ways to improve your ability to stay focused.
cues.en: there are ways to improve your ability to stay focused.
cues.zh: 都有方法可以提升 自己持續專注的能力。

cues.text: First, tasks that appropriately challenge you tend to hold your attention best.
cues.en: First, tasks that appropriately challenge you tend to hold your attention best.
cues.zh: 首先，具有適度挑戰性的任務， 通常最能維持我們的注意力。

cues.text: For example, you might focus better when working on a more difficult,
cues.en: For example, you might focus better when working on a more difficult,
cues.zh: 比如說，比起較簡單的拼圖，

cues.text: intricately patterned puzzle than an easier one.
cues.en: intricately patterned puzzle than an easier one.
cues.zh: 你可能更能專注於 難度較高、圖案更複雜的拼圖。

cues.text: Of course, we don’t always have a choice in what needs to get done.
cues.en: Of course, we don’t always have a choice in what needs to get done.
cues.zh: 當然，對於自己必須完成的任務， 我們不見得有所選擇。

cues.text: In these situations, it’s helpful to remember that if focusing feels like work,
cues.en: In these situations, it’s helpful to remember that if focusing feels like work,
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，記住一點會很有幫助：

cues.text: that's because it is.
cues.en: that's because it is.
cues.zh: 事實上，有些研究人員提出理論，

cues.text: In fact, some researchers theorize that attention is a limited resource.
cues.en: In fact, some researchers theorize that attention is a limited resource.
cues.zh: 事實上，有些研究人員提出理論，

cues.text: When you start focusing on something, this resource is at its highest,
cues.en: When you start focusing on something, this resource is at its highest,
cues.zh: 當你開始專注於某件事時， 這項資源最為充足，

cues.text: but it depletes over time,
cues.en: but it depletes over time,
cues.zh: 但隨著時間，它會逐漸消耗，

cues.text: leading to more mistakes and increasing the chance you’ll be distracted.
cues.en: leading to more mistakes and increasing the chance you’ll be distracted.
cues.zh: 導致犯錯的次數增加， 也更容易受到幹擾。

cues.text: Multitasking only increases the demand for this resource,
cues.en: Multitasking only increases the demand for this resource,
cues.zh: 一心多用只會增加對這項資源的需求，

cues.text: exhausting attentional stores more quickly.
cues.en: exhausting attentional stores more quickly.
cues.zh: 讓注意力儲備更快耗盡。

cues.text: That's why focusing on one task
cues.en: That's why focusing on one task
cues.zh: 因此，專注於一項任務， 並刻意安排休息時間，會有所助益。

cues.text: and intentionally building in breaks can be helpful.
cues.en: and intentionally building in breaks can be helpful.
cues.zh: 因此，專注於一項任務， 並刻意安排休息時間，會有所助益。

cues.text: Studies even show a momentary break, to get a snack or just zone out,
cues.en: Studies even show a momentary break, to get a snack or just zone out,
cues.zh: 研究甚至顯示，短暫休息， 去吃點零食，或只是放空一下，

cues.text: can reset this attentional resource.
cues.en: can reset this attentional resource.
cues.zh: 都能讓這項注意力資源重新恢復。

cues.text: And this strategy may be extra beneficial when studying or practicing a new skill.
cues.en: And this strategy may be extra beneficial when studying or practicing a new skill.
cues.zh: 而這種策略在學習 或練習新技能時，尤其有益。

cues.text: During breaks, our minds replay the neural activity patterns
cues.en: During breaks, our minds replay the neural activity patterns
cues.zh: 休息期間，我們的大腦會重播 剛學會的內容所產生的神經活動模式，

cues.text: of what you just learned,
cues.en: of what you just learned,
cues.zh: 這會將記憶鞏固下來，長期留存。

cues.text: helping to solidify the memory for the long term.
cues.en: helping to solidify the memory for the long term.
cues.zh: 這會將記憶鞏固下來，長期留存。

cues.text: Speaking of studying, stress, sleepiness, and poor mood
cues.en: Speaking of studying, stress, sleepiness, and poor mood
cues.zh: 說到學習，壓力、睡意和低落的情緒，

cues.text: can all weaken our ability to block out distractions.
cues.en: can all weaken our ability to block out distractions.
cues.zh: 都會削弱我們排除幹擾的能力。

cues.text: So activities that reduce stress,
cues.en: So activities that reduce stress,
cues.zh: 因此，減輕壓力的活動，

cues.text: like exercising, chatting with friends, or getting a good night’s sleep,
cues.en: like exercising, chatting with friends, or getting a good night’s sleep,
cues.zh: 像是運動、和朋友聊天或睡個好覺，

cues.text: also make it easier to stay focused.
cues.en: also make it easier to stay focused.
cues.zh: 也會讓我們更容易保持專注。

cues.text: And nature may offer an extra boost.
cues.en: And nature may offer an extra boost.
cues.zh: 再者，大自然還能提供額外的助力。

cues.text: In one study, a 15-minute walk outdoors led to greater improvements
cues.en: In one study, a 15-minute walk outdoors led to greater improvements
cues.zh: 一項研究發現，戶外散步 15 分鐘， 比在室內走同樣的時間，

cues.text: in lab-based attention tasks than the same walk indoors.
cues.en: in lab-based attention tasks than the same walk indoors.
cues.zh: 更能改善受試者在注意力測驗的表現。

cues.text: Another effective strategy is mindfulness meditation.
cues.en: Another effective strategy is mindfulness meditation.
cues.zh: 另一個有效的方法是正念冥想。

cues.text: This practice is all about staying in the present moment
cues.en: This practice is all about staying in the present moment
cues.zh: 這種練習著重於停留在當下，

cues.text: through exercises like spending 12 minutes focusing on the sensations of breathing,
cues.en: through exercises like spending 12 minutes focusing on the sensations of breathing,
cues.zh: 例如花 12 分鐘專注於呼吸時的感受，

cues.text: which can help train your attention over time.
cues.en: which can help train your attention over time.
cues.zh: 長期下來有助訓練注意力。

cues.text: But before you go take a walk, grab a snack, or learn to meditate,
cues.en: But before you go take a walk, grab a snack, or learn to meditate,
cues.zh: 不過，在你準備去散步、 拿點零食或學習冥想之前，

cues.text: there’s something much easier you can do right in this moment:
cues.en: there’s something much easier you can do right in this moment:
cues.zh: 其實有一件更簡單的事， 你現在就可以做：

cues.text: get rid of distractions.
cues.en: get rid of distractions.
cues.zh: 消除幹擾。

cues.text: It’s impossible to remove every distraction,
cues.en: It’s impossible to remove every distraction,
cues.zh: 雖然我們不可能排除所有幹擾，

cues.text: after all, our own wandering minds are often the biggest culprits.
cues.en: after all, our own wandering minds are often the biggest culprits.
cues.zh: 光是我們自己飄忽不定的思緒， 往往就是最主要的源頭。

cues.text: But one recent survey estimated that Americans now check their phones
cues.en: But one recent survey estimated that Americans now check their phones
cues.zh: 但最近一項調查估計，美國人 現在每天檢視手機大約 200 次。

cues.text: around 200 times a day.
cues.en: around 200 times a day.
cues.zh: 螢幕上的各種內容，往往經過設計， 就是要吸引並持續抓住我們的注意力。

cues.text: The distractions on our screens are designed to grab and hold attention.
cues.en: The distractions on our screens are designed to grab and hold attention.
cues.zh: 螢幕上的各種內容，往往經過設計， 就是要吸引並持續抓住我們的注意力。

cues.text: So, remember to be kind to yourself.
cues.en: So, remember to be kind to yourself.
cues.zh: 所以，記得善待自己。

cues.text: While we can’t always control every factor that pulls at our attention,
cues.en: While we can’t always control every factor that pulls at our attention,
cues.zh: 雖然我們無法控制 所有牽動注意力的因素，

cues.text: finding a quiet environment, closing extra tabs,
cues.en: finding a quiet environment, closing extra tabs,
cues.zh: 但找個安靜的環境、關閉多餘的分頁，

cues.text: and even blocking certain apps
cues.en: and even blocking certain apps
cues.zh: 甚至封鎖某些應用程式，

cues.text: can give your brain the best chance at focusing in.
cues.en: can give your brain the best chance at focusing in.
cues.zh: 都能幫助我們更專心。
